body.x: “CES(Consumer Electronics Show) 2018 Media Days” event was opened today (January 7, 2018 in local time) in Las Vegas, USA before the main event, CES 2018 which is the world’s biggest IT electronics exhibition.

Jackqueline Cooper at Muse explained, “the head band which senses the brain waves uses the technologies which help the user in the external activities such as cycling, yoga, and even computer games.” He added, “it is more important to collect meaningful and precise data than to simply track the data.”

Of the sleep technologies, he anticipated, “in the future we won’t need sleep laboratories anymore”, and “we will see the advent of wearable devices which help the wearer sleep and enhance the quality of the wearer’s sleep.”

CES, the world's largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
